q: 默写：What’s the ___ of your visit?（填 purpose）
a: What's the purpose of your visit?  答：I'm here on tourism.

q: 默写：How long are you ___?（填 staying 的正确形式）
a: How long are you staying?  答：Three weeks.（注意 stay 要加 -ing）

q: 默写：Do you have anything to ___?（填 declare）
a: Do you have anything to declare?  答：No, nothing.
